description: This is a Java class 'JwtTokenService' responsible for creating, parsing, and validating JWT tokens for authentication purposes in a security module. It includes methods for generating access and refresh tokens, parsing JWTs to extract claims, and checking token types.

classes.name: JwtTokenService
classes.description: Service class for handling JSON Web Token (JWT) creation and validation, mainly used for authentication and authorization processes.

methods.name: createAccessToken
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT access token containing user ID, email, and roles, with an expiration based on access TTL.

methods.name: createRefreshToken
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT refresh token containing user ID, with an expiration based on refresh TTL.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a JWT token string to extract its claims after verifying the signature.

methods.name: isRefreshToken
methods.description: Checks if the provided claims correspond to a refresh token based on the 'typ' claim.

methods.name: getExpiration
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration time of the token from its claims.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Extracts the list of roles from the token's claims.
